notes.title: Paresis v1.2 - Difficulty Rework v2
notes.content:
CHANGES


 AI 3 Bathroom will now turn off less frequently and will stay off for less time on Normal Difficulty.
 All lights, except Basement on Hardcore, that turn off on all Difficulties, will now turn off less often and stay off for less time.

notes.title: Paresis v1.2 - Difficulty Rework
notes.content:
CHANGES


 Phase 2 (Level 4) and Phase 1 (Level 5) on Normal, forth AI in Basement will no longer have the light turn on and off. This will only be on Hardcore. Now you can always see the forth AI in the Basement but you can also hear the AI right before it attacks. 
 Phase 1 (Level 5) on Normal will no longer have an AI above the player until Hardcore mode. All AI will still be faster on TTK but should allow more players to beat Normal Difficulty more easily. 
 Hardcore on Phase 2 (Level 4) and Phase 1 (Level 5), Kitchen AI will always have a death sound. This was meant to make the game more unpredictable but has now been reversed because of the Normal Difficulty changes.

notes.title: The Under | Major Update v1.2
notes.content:
NEW

   •	New Location

   •	5 More Phases

   •	New Steam Achievements for DLC

   •	Main Menu has a new button to take you to the Under.

   •	Temporary Halloween Décor for Halloween Season (Scary Pumpkins etc.) 

   •	Amica the Bunny added if player completes normal difficulty (Amica will destroy all Morphs 
        present with his Flame. He will laugh right before he attacks.) Amica will be added to all Normal 
        Phases and Hardcore for both the Under and Main Game.

   •	Amica the Bunny is now part of Hardcore and is helpful for beating the Phases on this difficulty.

   •	Amica the Bunny can be upgraded further if the player completes Hardcore. This will make Amica 
        use blue flame energy and when he attacks he will destroy enemies for 5 seconds. The cooldown 
        between attacks will be faster as well. In the Under, Amica will reveal Morphs with Blue Flame and 
        will use ability faster if Hardcore is completed.



CHANGES

   •	Main Menu has sound for picking new game and the back button.

   •	Audio has been reduced slightly on the Main Menu and during each Phase for comfort.

   •	Mouse Sensitivity can now be changed within the Options Menu and is still possible in levels with 
        number keys.



THE UNDER DLC

   •	5 Normal Difficulty Phases

   •	5 Hardcore Difficulty Phases

   • 	The Under has its own Main Menu.

   •	5 New Enemies with their own abilities.

   •	New Ability Blue Flame (Blue Flame will reveal certain morphs that may be invisible while walking 
        towards the player and will be important for killing specific morphs. It has a cooldown of 10 
        seconds for every use.)

   •	Amica the Bunny can also be unlocked and upgraded with completion of Normal and Hardcore 
        Difficulty.

   •	Upgrading Blue Flame is passive after each Phase. However, you can decrease the cooldown 
        further for each Phase if you can find the clock within the After Level.

   •	You can walk in the After Levels and find a clock. This also includes some new mechanics where 
        you can move boxes to climb onto crates to collect a clock depending on the After Level.

notes.title: Paresis v1.1 - Low Graphics Shadows Overhaul/Menu Improvements
notes.content:

 Main Menu has better UI when picking a New Game. This will also showcase the Hardcore Mode but will be unavailable until completion of the core Phases. Hardcore will be grey until its available.

notes.title: Paresis: The Under DLC
notes.content:
Halloween Seasonal Update for Paresis/DLC *All DLC will be free content downloads



Features to Expect within DLC


 Brand new Menu for Paresis: The Under DLC
 Five more Phases included within the DLC
 Gameplay is fresh and new compared to Paresis's main game
 Brand new enemies to encounter throughout each Phase
 New ability to reveal the Morphs and replaces the leaning mechanic
 New story details and hidden easter eggs


Features to Expect for Patch v1.2


 Minor Fixes in general
 Halloween décor (including scary pumpkins etc.)
 Possible changes may include adjusted difficulty to hardcore mode etc.
 Amica the Bunny is a Permanent Reward if the player completes Normal Mode and upgraded Amica will be available upon completion of Hardcore Mode. Amica will act as a companion and will use fire to help the player. This feature will also be included within the DLC if the player completes Normal and Hardcore.
